name: client-storage-uploadbytes-root-ref
description: firebase/storage uploadBytes(ref(storage), data) on the root reference: observes synchronous FirebaseError storage/invalid-root-operation client-side preflight with zero network requests.

behavior.message: Firebase Storage: The operation 'uploadBytes' cannot be performed on a root reference, create a non-root reference using child, such as .child('file.png'). (storage/invalid-root-operation)
